question: Which of the following constellation is also called the hunter?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Orion.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Orion** is named after a** hunter** from Greek mythology, known for his exceptional hunting skills and strength.
 
• According to the myth, Orion was eventually placed among the stars as a constellation after his death.
 
• It is known for its bright stars, including** Betelgeuse and Rigel**, which are among the brightest stars in the night sky.
 
• These stars contribute to the** distinct shape and visibility** of the constellation.
